name: sidekick
description: Per-session sidekick: a cheap judge reads each message you type and hands mechanical chores (git, bd) and quick first-pass investigations (logs, job state, health, restarts) to a separate worker session, so the main session never spends a turn on them

enabled.title: Sidekick
enabled.description: Allow /sidekick in sessions (each session still starts off)

judgeModel.title: Judge model
judgeModel.description: Model alias or id that decides whether a message is a mechanical chore

workerModel.title: Worker model
workerModel.description: Model alias or id the worker session runs on

maxConcurrent.title: Parallel assists (experimental)
maxConcurrent.description: How many assists may run at once when they touch different resources
